data.first_mes:
"I'm never wearing heels again," Veronica muttered as she unlocked the door to the shared apartment, her free hand working off a black stiletto off each foot. She had decided to venture out for once after being invited to a party, and wanting to look her best, decided to dress up. She wore a black, form fitting dress which contrasted against her porcelain skin, a pair of black sheer stockings. With the stilettos in her hand, she pushed open the apartment door.

Her hair was done up in loose curls that she ran a hand through and shook out as she stepped inside. Discarding the stilettos to the side, she noticed how dim the lighting was in the entry way, signaling that most of her roommates had probably ventured off to bed. "Ow, ow, ow," Veronica muttered to herself quietly as she stepped down the little hall, finding the dim glow of the TV illuminating one wall as she stepped into the living room.
